description: Generate a weekly report for a client. Use when you need a formatted report. Do NOT use when you need to adjust the report's text; use render_report_text instead.

accomplishments.description: A list of accomplishments achieved during the week

blockers.description: A list of issues or obstacles encountered during the week

client_name.description: The name of the client for whom the report is being generated

hours_logged.description: The total number of hours worked during the week

next_week.description: A list of tasks planned for the next week

week_start.description: The start date of the week in YYYY-MM-DD format
